blocks.title: One contractor for the civil package.
blocks.body:
General contractors and construction managers bring us in to deliver the civil and excavation package on schools, housing and commercial projects: bulk and detail excavation, shoring, underground utilities, site servicing, concrete and paving.

We have worked for Keller Construction on Agnes Street supportive housing in New Westminster, for Kinetic Construction on the Applied Science Digital Design Studio at UBC, for SmartCentres on the Chilliwack Mall redevelopment. We also deliver full civil packages on school projects in Surrey, Richmond, New Westminster and Burnaby.

items.title: Bulk and detail excavation
items.text: Excavation for foundations and building pads.

items.title: Shoring and trench boxes
items.text: Trench shoring for deep utility and foundation work.

items.title: Site servicing
items.text: Storm, sanitary and water services from the building to the city mains.

items.title: Earthworks and grading
items.text: Fill, compaction, granular base and final grading.

items.title: Concrete and paving
items.text: Curb, gutter, sidewalks, slabs and paving coordination.

items.title: Schedule and safety
items.text: Our own crews and equipment, COR certified safety, one point of contact.

items.q: Do you work as a subcontractor to general contractors?
items.a: Yes. We deliver civil and excavation packages for general contractors and construction managers, including Keller Construction and Kinetic Construction.

items.q: Can you price from tender drawings?
items.a: Yes. Send the tender package to info@nscltd.ca and our estimating team will respond within one business day. See [Tenders and bids](tenders.html).
Yes. Our safety program is COR certified by the BC Construction Safety Alliance. See [Safety](safety.html).

blocks.title: Need a civil subcontractor?
blocks.text: Send drawings, a tender package or a prequalification request. Our estimating team will respond within one business day.
